designPhilosophy.summary: A virtual companion that grows alongside Hakan as he studies math. Stars earned from quizzes feed the pet automatically — no extra chores, no guilt loops. Pets are warm, encouraging, and remember Hakan by name. The Tamagotchi-style daily-return incentive is positive-only: pets never die, never get sick, just get a little sleepy or miss Hakan when he's away.
principles: Playing IS feeding — stars do double duty
No punishment for absence — pet gets sleepy, not sick
Every pet talks to Hakan by name in a unique voice
Growth is permanent — evolutions never regress
Tappable info card is the main interaction (low cognitive load)

growthRule.description: The pet grows automatically based on TOTAL stars earned across all modules. Playing IS feeding — no separate currency, no chore loop. Stars never decrease, so the pet can never regress.
notes: Stars are a non-spending currency for growth — they do not get 'used up'.
If we later add other reward sinks (sticker shop, etc.), use a SEPARATE coin currency. Stars must remain a permanent, cumulative count.
When Hakan unlocks a new stage, show a celebratory full-screen burst: pet's new emoji + sparkles + stage name + warm message.
Show a soft 'progress to next stage' bar on the info card (e.g., 'Sparky is 60% to becoming a Young Dragon!').

decayRule.note: Pet never reaches 0 — it caps at 10 (sleepy/missing-you) so Hakan never feels guilty.

factors: Time since last visit (longer = sleepier, not sadder)
Recent quiz performance (wins make pet happy)
Total time today (a quick check-in is enough — no grind required)

interactions.frequency: occasional (every 3rd wrong, not every wrong — avoid noise)

Hakan and {petName} have earned {totalStars} stars together!

petPicker.design: 5 large pet cards, each showing the Stage 1 emoji + name + personality blurb. Tap to preview a Stage 4 'sneak peek' of how the pet grows.

switchingPolicy.rule: Hakan can switch active pet any time. Each pet keeps its own growth (total stars apply to ALL pets — they all grow with the same star pool).
switchingPolicy.rationale: We don't want Hakan to feel locked in at age 6. All pets share the same star pool so switching never feels like 'starting over'.

homeScreen.position: Top-center, large (~120px), above the modules grid
homeScreen.speechBubble: Small bubble appears for 4s when pet has a fresh message (after quiz, on streak, on return)
homeScreen.happinessIndicator: Tiny colored dot on pet (green=happy, yellow=content, blue=sleepy)

parentDashboard.position: Header card, alongside Hakan's name and streak
parentDashboard.purpose: Reinforces continuity for parent — shows whose pet, current stage, total stars

celebrationOverlay.trigger: stage-up only (used sparingly to keep the moment special)
celebrationOverlay.design: Full-screen, soft-color gradient, pet emoji huge with sparkle ring, name + new stage banner, 'Continue' button

accessibility.readingLevel: All pet messages stay at Grade-1 reading level — short words, simple phrases.
accessibility.audioOption: Each pet message has an optional audio playback (TTS or recorded) so a pre-reader can still hear it.
accessibility.skipAnimations: Parent setting to reduce motion — bounce/wiggle becomes a fade.
accessibility.noTimePressure: Pet never urges Hakan to hurry. Messages are slow, warm, patient.

parentControls.petEnabled: On/off toggle (some parents may prefer plain UI)
parentControls.messageStyle: Choice of 'chatty' (default) or 'minimal' (1 message per session max)
parentControls.petSwitchLock: Optional — lock pet choice so Hakan doesn't flip-flop every session

track: happiness-state-distribution (how often pet is happy vs sleepy)
telemetry.doNotTrack: No PII beyond the existing app's local-only profile. Pet data is local.

futureIdeas: Seasonal pet outfits (winter scarf in December, etc.) — purely cosmetic
Photo mode: take a screenshot of Hakan + pet to share with grandparents
Pet duets: when Hakan and a sibling both have pets, they wave at each other on shared family device
Pet's 'favorite module' — adapts based on which modules Hakan plays most, suggests favorites first
